test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who has taken oath as Bihar Chief Minister for 8th time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitish Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nitish Kumar on 10 August 2022 took oath as the Bihar chief minister for the eighth time.
 
• Nitish Kumar has earlier served as the Union Minister under PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee.
 
• Tejashwi Yadav was also administered the oath of office as deputy CM in a ceremony at Raj Bhawan.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bihar:

 
 
• Capital: Patna
 
• Governor: Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar
 
• Lok Sabha seats - 40.
 
• Rajya Sabha seats - 16.
 
• State Animal - Gaur.
 
• State Bird - House sparrow.
 
• National Park - Valmiki National Park.
